_provenance.honest_status: ASSEMBLED, NOT CAPTURED. No response body from http://distribution.virk.dk/cvr-permanent/virksomhed/_search has ever been seen by this repository: that endpoint answers 401 and the credentials Erhvervsstyrelsen issues are not held here. This file proves the parser, the guards and the scrubbing. It does NOT prove that Denmark's live data looks like this, and no number in it is a measurement of anything.
_provenance.what_is_verified: Every FIELD NAME and every nesting level below was read out of the production mapping at http://distribution.virk.dk/cvr-permanent/_mapping on 2026-09-09, which is PUBLIC and needs no credential. The envelope (hits.hits[]._source.Vrvirksomhed, _index cvr-v-20220630, _type _doc) and the shape of one real deltagerRelation - including an organisation whose period differs from its medlemsData period - follow a real captured CVR document published by a third party and independently corroborated by four open-source clients of this same endpoint.
_provenance.what_is_invented: The people, the dates and the employee figures. Names are ordinary Danish names and belong to nobody in particular; the company names and CVR numbers of the first four are real and public, chosen so the modulus-11 check is exercised on genuine numbers. 30000005 and 30000013 are synthetic but valid; 99999999 is deliberately invalid. The band code vocabulary is second-hand (two independent open-source clients), NOT read from a response.
_provenance.personal_data: Every participant keeps beliggenhedsadresse, postadresse, enhedsNummer, forretningsnoegle and adresseHemmelig exactly as CVR publishes them, because the point of the personal-data tests is that none of it reaches a stored row.
_provenance.the_seven: 24256790 both directions in one company plus a legal person on the board and an auditor; 22756214 an unknown FUNKTION value that must be declined and counted; 61126228 a beneficial-owners organ and an event outside the window; 10403782 below the band floor; 30000005 reklamebeskyttet; 30000013 organisation period and membership period disagreeing; 99999999 a CVR number that fails modulus-11.
